description: Reads the person's own conversations with people they connected with at an event. Needs a personal connector token. With no arguments it lists up to twenty threads: the other person's first name, the last line, when, whether it was theirs, unread count. With `firstName` or `chatId` it returns that conversation's last lines. No row carries a phone number, email address, surname, account id or photo. Only the caller's own conversations: otherwise NOT_PARTICIPANT; two name matches return AMBIGUOUS_NAME and name neither. It only reads and marks nothing read.

chatId.description: Optional conversation id from a thread row.

firstName.description: Optional first name from a thread row.

limit.description: Optional lines of one conversation, at most 50 (default 30).

name: event_inbox
title: Read my messages
